questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The time period of revolution of a geostationary satellite around the Earth is:
questions.explanation: A geostationary satellite must match the Earth's rotation, so it orbits once in 24 hours in the equatorial plane at a height of about 36000 km.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The work done in moving a test charge from one point to another on an equipotential surface is:
questions.explanation: Potential is the same at every point of the surface, so the potential difference and hence the work W = qΔV is zero. The field is always normal to such a surface.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 2: Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The magnetic field well inside a long current carrying solenoid having n turns per unit length is:
questions.explanation: Ampere's circuital law gives B = μ₀nI, a field that is uniform and independent of the radius, which is why solenoids are used to make uniform fields.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 4: Moving Charges and Magnetism

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: The electron gain enthalpy of chlorine is more negative than that of fluorine because:
options: Chlorine is more electronegative than fluorine
The small 2p subshell of fluorine has high electron-electron repulsion
Chlorine has a smaller atomic size
Fluorine has a higher nuclear charge than chlorine
questions.explanation: The incoming electron enters the compact 2p subshell of fluorine where repulsion is severe, so less energy is released than for chlorine, whose larger 3p subshell accommodates it more easily.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A solution showing positive deviation from Raoult's law has:
options: Stronger A-B interactions than A-A and B-B
Weaker A-B interactions than A-A and B-B
No change in volume on mixing
questions.explanation: Weaker interactions between unlike molecules let them escape more easily, so vapour pressure is higher than predicted and both ΔH(mix) and ΔV(mix) are positive, as with ethanol and acetone.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The number of different amino acids commonly found in proteins is:
questions.explanation: Twenty amino acids build all natural proteins. The figure 64 belongs to the number of codons in the genetic code, not to amino acids.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: For every molecule of CO₂ fixed in the Calvin cycle, the number of ATP and NADPH molecules required is:
questions.explanation: Fixing six CO₂ into one glucose needs 18 ATP and 12 NADPH, which works out to 3 ATP and 2 NADPH per CO₂.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 11: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The correct sequence of primary succession on a bare rock is:
options: Mosses to lichens to herbs to trees
Lichens to mosses to herbs and shrubs to trees
Herbs to lichens to mosses to trees
Trees to shrubs to mosses to lichens
questions.explanation: Lichens are the pioneer species on rock, secreting acids that break it into soil. Mosses follow, then herbs and shrubs, and finally a forest climax community.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The Widal test is used in the diagnosis of:
questions.explanation: Widal detects antibodies against Salmonella typhi, the bacterium that causes typhoid and spreads through contaminated food and water.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which hormone is known as the emergency or fight-or-flight hormone?
questions.explanation: Adrenaline from the adrenal medulla raises heart rate, breathing rate and blood glucose, readying the body to deal with sudden stress.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 19: Chemical Coordination and Integration
